name: reactive-state-demo
description: Roku showcase for flash-theater's reactive-state surface — field/derived basics and derived's own static type inference (plus its unknown escape hatch), state's private m.x-backed writes and field-shadowing gotcha, the schemaless global store's read (one-time) vs. watch (reactive) distinction, and field/state array/assocarray literal defaults — a dedicated, router-mounted chapter app for the reactive-state doc-nav topic (see findings/demo-app-conventions.md).

scripts.build:roku: npm run compile && npm run zip
